entity.goetia.imp.name: Imp
entity.goetia.fiend.name: Fiend
entity.goetia.demon.name: Demon
goetia.knowledge.impSymbol.desc: Summons an Imp above the symbol.
goetia.knowledge.fiendSymbol.desc: Summons a Fiend above the symbol.
goetia.knowledge.demonSymbol.desc: Summons a Demon above the symbol.
goetia.knowledge.forgeSymbol.desc: Imbues certain items with bound demons.
goetia.knowledge.openSoulSymbol.desc: Binds demons to your soul itself.
goetia.spell.burningTouch.desc: Scorch all foes that you strike.
goetia.spell.fireball.desc: Casts a powerful explosive fireball before you.
goetia.spell.rebuke.desc: Pushes back any who dare strike you.
goetia.spell.bloodrain.desc: Your life essence extends from you, weakening creatures it contacts.
goetia.spell.innerFire.desc: Charged by unholiness, you become faster and stronger, but also more vulnerable.
goetia.spell.fallenArmor.desc: Grants you extra protection, as long as you continue causing pain.
goetia.spell.chainedStrikes.desc: Your attacks are made so ferocious that you tear into the innocent nearby.
goetia.spell.ebonWings.desc: A dark curtain of malevolence propels you skyward, granting you flight for a time.
goetia.spell.voraciousStrike.desc: Your bare fists can punch straight through entities during their invulnerability period.
goetia.spell.innerGrace.desc: Tapping into your angelic power you becoming faster and stronger.
goetia.spell.angelicWings.desc: By defying gravity itself you are granted temporary flight.
goetia.spell.angelicGrowth.desc: You are able to command crops around you to grow much faster.
goetia.spell.smite.desc: Using your holy powers you are able to smite evil
goetia.spell.storm.desc: Command the sky to punish those around you
guide.goetia.goetia.title: Goetia
guide.goetia.goetia.desc: Goetia is a mod made for the first "The Modding Trials", created in under 96 hours. It's a magic mod based around summoning demons and other entities to use them for various magical purposes.
guide.goetia.notes.title: Lost Notes
guide.goetia.notes.desc: You can find long lost notes in dungeon chest that contain knowledge about the various symbols you can make use of.
